gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could read puts a same-day (2026-11-21) store price on every board in its two answers, and none prices the Gamakay NS68: at $36.79 wired it sits below the three other 65% Hall effect boards read today ($41.65 to $42.49), and $39.99 buys it with 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth, while the cheapest wireless board in ChatGPT's answers is the $103.99 Keychron K2 HE at 1,000 Hz.
standout_why: Compared against mechanicalkeyboard.net (six boards, prices checked 2026-11-10: K617 HE $39.99, HE68 Lite $49.99 list, MCHOSE Ace 68 V2 $69, RK C84 HE $74.99, AULA F75 HE $79.80, K686 HE $62.99), setupinsider.com (only Hall effect board is the K617 HE at about $40, undated) and gamepadsquire.com (HE68 Lite about $42, R85 HE about $62 in its table and $56.69 in its listing, K673 HE about $51, AULA F75 HE about $80, MonsGeek FUN60 Ultra TMR about $90, undated and inconsistent). None of the three mentions the Gamakay NS68, NS75 or TK75HE, or the MCHOSE Ace 60 Pro, and none carries Black Friday prices; their cheapest wireless Hall effect board is the AULA F75 HE at about $80. Caveat: the bodies of the two cited pages (PC Gamer's Hall effect guide, which names the NS68, and the RTINGS rapid trigger article) did not load, so PC Gamer may state an NS68 price. The price ladder is partly on rival pages (hence not 3); the NS68's position in it and the wired-versus-wireless split by price are new.
decides: Price alone does not separate the sub-$45 boards: the six read today span $33.99 to $42.49. Layout and connection decide. ChatGPT's first pick, the MCHOSE Ace 60 Pro, lists from $37.40 on MCHOSE's store today (below the $41.65 ChatGPT showed) and stays a fair 60% wired pick. The Gamakay NS68 wired ($36.79) undercuts it and the HE68 Lite ($42.49) while keeping the 65% layout, so on today's prices it takes 'budget rapid trigger with arrow keys'; the tri-mode NS68 ($39.99) takes 'wireless under $50', pending the maker's wireless polling figure, which I could not read. In 75%, the Gamakay NS75 (tri-mode) is $4 above the wired Redragon K673 HE ($59.99) on the 2026-11-21 reads. The NS68 has no Dealectric record yet and would need one for this page; the NS75 is the linked row that fits the question.
